observations: The reader keeps its UI styling out of the reconstruction: the head carries one style block (55,797 bytes, 415 rules) and the content carries its own inline Word styling.
No filter or invert() is applied to images; the dark theme remaps inline colours instead (pixel contrast for the cover and photographs is unchanged in both themes).

The sticky toolbar keeps a 44 px height on wide viewports and wraps to 70 px below 768 px; the navigation offset is published as --b2-nav-offset from the measured toolbar geometry (76 px desktop, 96 px narrow, 106 px when the toolbar wraps at 1024).
Fixed pixel widths are confined to small UI affordances (17 declarations); no content column is fixed, and no viewport produced horizontal overflow.
